classification.difficultyReason: Sketch horizontal and vertical lines and lines through the origin using one additional point.

answer.worked: Every point has $x$-coordinate $3$. Draw the vertical line through $(3,0)$.

spec.description: Unshaded axes and a vertical line through the labelled point (3,0); no ticks or grid.

answer.worked: When $x=0$, $y=0$. When $x=1$, $y=2(1)=2$. Draw the straight line through $(0,0)$ and $(1,2)$.

spec.description: Line through the origin and labelled point (1,2), with axes but no ticks or grid.

answer.worked: When $x=0$, $y=0$. When $x=-1$, $y=-2(-1)=2$. Draw the straight line through $(0,0)$ and $(-1,2)$.

spec.description: Line through the origin and labelled point (-1,2), with axes but no ticks or grid.

answer.worked: Every point has $y$-coordinate $4$. Draw the horizontal line through $(0,4)$.

answer.worked: When $x=0$, $y=0$. When $x=-1$, $y=-4(-1)=4$. Draw the straight line through $(0,0)$ and $(-1,4)$.

answer.worked: When $x=0$, $y=0$. When $x=4$, $y=\frac14(4)=1$. Draw the straight line through $(0,0)$ and $(4,1)$.
